name: Filipino Chicken Adobo with Rice

components.name: Chicken Adobo
steps: Combine chicken, 8 g garlic, vinegar, soy sauce, peppercorns, bay leaves and 120 ml water in a deep pot. Bring gently to a boil.
Add bouillon and sugar, cover and simmer about 20 minutes, turning the chicken halfway, until the meat is cooked.
Lift chicken onto a plate. Heat oil in a second pan and sauté the remaining garlic, then briefly brown chicken pieces on each side.
Pour adobo liquid into the pan and simmer uncovered until reduced to a glossy sauce; check the thickest chicken pieces reach at least 74°C.
Remove bay leaves and portion with cooked rice. Refrigerate promptly; freeze later-week containers.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Rinse the rice and place it with 420 ml water and 3 g salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, then simmer on very low heat until absorbed; rest covered for 10 minutes.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Source adobo is four servings; UNHANGRY adds dry rice as a full lunch/dinner. Chicken is weighed bone-in; edible yield varies.
Storing & reheating: Freeze chicken and sauce separate from rice for best texture; cool rice rapidly.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.

Rice must be rapidly cooled and chilled; never leave cooked rice standing for extended periods.
